subject: Reschedule request: demo timing aligned with ACME budget/CFO review
messages:
From: Michael Rossi <michael.rossi@acme-logistics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liz Chen <liz.chen@acme-logistics.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo request — procurement & budget timing

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We’re interested in seeing Redwood’s inference platform for a pilot around routing and ETA generation. Procurement asked that we coordinate demonstrations around our upcoming FY budget review — CFO has a final read on vendor spend the week of Aug 16–20.

Can we target dates the following week (Aug 23–27)? If you have a 30–45 minute slot then, that would be great. Also—when you reply, could you include a short mutual action plan and any SOW template so our procurement team can triage ahead of the demo?

Appreciate it,
Michael
Michael Rossi
Head of Platform Engineering | ACME Logistics
attachments: none
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Rossi <michael.rossi@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Liz Chen <liz.chen@acme-logistics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request — procurement & budget timing

Hi Michael — great to connect.

Thanks for the heads up on the CFO window. We can absolutely move the demo to Aug 23–27; I have a few slots open on Aug 24 and Aug 25 (PST). Marcus (cc’d) will join for the product deep dive and Priyom can join the technical Q&A depending on which slot you pick.

I’ve attached a short mutual action plan and a draft SOW so procurement has context. If your procurement team wants to fast-follow a DocuSign flow after the demo, we can prepare that.

Proposed slots (all 30–45m):
- Tue, Aug 24 — 10:00–10:45 PT
- Tue, Aug 24 — 14:00–14:45 PT
- Wed, Aug 25 — 11:00–11:45 PT

If CFO wants to surface one specific cost/latency target for us to focus on during the pilot review, let me know and we’ll tailor the demo.

Cheers,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
attachments: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOW_draft_v0.9.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Intro + demo request — procurement & budget timing

Eve — quick internal note before we confirm a slot with ACME:

- Procurement is explicitly tying vendor pilots to the quarter-close cadence this cycle. If CFO delays, ACME is likely to push vendor approvals until after their final FY budget is signed.
- If they land on Aug 24/25, we should treat it as a technical discovery only (no pricing negotiation). Post-demo, propose a short follow-up workshop with procurement + finance to lock on pricing once their budget read is confirmed.
- Priyom: can you prepare a 5-slide appendix on cost-per-token & batching profiles (tailored to ACME routing volumes) and a short note on private deployment network options? I’ll put this under Evelyn’s name as follow-up deliverable.

Let’s keep the proposed slots available but frame the call as discovery — we don’t want to force legal/pricing before CFO signs off.

Thanks,
Marcus
VP, Solutions & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Rossi <michael.rossi@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Liz Chen <liz.chen@acme-logistics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request — procurement & budget timing

Hi Michael — quick update from our side.

We’ll hold open the Aug 24 and Aug 25 slots listed below for a 30–45 minute discovery demo focused on technical fit and pilot scoping. Per Marcus, we’ll avoid pricing negotiation until your finance/CFO call completes. After the demo we’ll send an appendix with cost profiles and a proposed timeline for procurement steps so your team can review ahead of the CFO decision.

Confirmed available slots (please pick one):
- Tue, Aug 24 — 10:00–10:45 PT (Evelyn, Marcus)
- Tue, Aug 24 — 14:00–14:45 PT (Evelyn, Priyom)
- Wed, Aug 25 — 11:00–11:45 PT (Evelyn, Marcus, Priyom)

Attachments included: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan) and SOW_draft_v0.9.pdf — procurement can use these to start internal triage.

If CFO confirms earlier, we’re happy to accelerate follow-ups. Otherwise, pick a slot and we’ll calendar and send an agenda.

Thanks,
Evelyn

Let’s lock Tue, Aug 24 at 14:00 PT (Evelyn + Priyom). We’ll treat it as discovery and have two procurement reps listen in. Please send calendar invite and final agenda.
